description: Beyond the paper. The paper's largest simulated size is m=30, where the Appendix B budget already covers only 0.2% of the space. At m=48 it covers 1e-08. No boson arm here -- the sampler costs 4.2x more per +4 modes and m=42 is the ceiling for a 30-instance arm. These interference-free arms are nearly free and map where the algorithm stops finding anything at all. Independent Bernoulli clicks at 1.15x the rate.
